mapper.update: UPDATE file_export_task SET progress_percent = #{progressPercent}, processed_rows = #{processedRows}, total_rows = #{totalRows}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') AND locked_by = #{workerId}

UPDATE file_export_task SET status = 'SUCCESS', progress_percent = 100, file_record_id = #{fileRecordId}, expire_at = #{expireAt}, finished_at = #{now}, locked_by = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND locked_by = #{workerId}

UPDATE file_export_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, next_retry_at = NULL, finished_at = #{now}, locked_by = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND locked_by = #{workerId}

UPDATE file_export_task SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, progress_percent = 0, processed_rows = 0, total_rows = NULL, file_record_id = NULL, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, locked_by = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND locked_by = #{workerId} AND retry_count < max_retry
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_record_id FROM file_export_task WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND file_record_id IS NOT NULL AND expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at < #{now} ORDER BY expire_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
